versions.changelog:
- Initial release of AIsa Tavily Hardened skill for AI-optimized web search.
- Enables concise and relevant web results via the Tavily API through AIsa's unified gateway.
- Provides command-line usage for searching queries and extracting content from URLs.
- Includes options for deep search, result count, topical searching (general/news), and news recency.
- Security guardrails restrict unauthorized content extraction, prevent unauthorized data transmission, and limit redundant queries.
